source_text: Deprecamur auditores non cum Iudaeis litteram solam sectari. Post Hiericho Iesus mittit ad Gai — paucos; terga vertunt. Peccatum in castris: Achan de anathemate furatus. Donec purgetur, non stabit populus ante hostes.
pass_a_gloss: We-beseech hearers not with Jews letter alone to-follow. After Jericho Jesus sends unto Ai — few; backs they-turn. Sin in camps: Achan from ban having-stolen. Until it-is-purged, not will-stand people before enemies.
pass_b_english: We beg hearers not to chase the bare letter with unbelieving readers. After Jericho Jesus sends a few against Ai; they turn their backs. Sin is in the camp: Achan has stolen from the ban. Until it is purged, the people cannot stand before enemies.
